About SPACE-SHIP

Building theintelligence layerfor renewable energy.

We combine Earth Observation, environmental data and AI to develop independent risk indices, forecasts and financial intelligence that connect physical conditions with renewable energy production, markets and financial risk.
Starting with hydropower, our products help insurers, lenders, operators and energy-market participants anticipate, price and transfer risk.

Alongside this focus, we continue to apply our EO and AI expertise to selected maritime projects and provide specialised Earth Observation consulting & capacity building.

01 — Why work with us

Independent data, domain depth and results you can verify.

Independent by design

Our indices use independently observable natural signals, not operator-controlled inputs, providing a consistent basis for every party to a decision.

Physical risk, financial context

We connect physical conditions with production, markets and financial risk - turning complex data into intelligence built around real decisions.

Traceable by default

Every figure is linked to its source and methodology. We label what is observed and what is modelled, and we say where the data stops.
